parsed.post: Huge jump to 1.019564! The lower LR (0.05) proved highly effective for stability and convergence within the 5-minute window. It seems we are in a sweet spot for learning. I'll now try to optimize the regularization by slightly increasing WEIGHT_DECAY to see if it helps further generalization.
parsed.description: Increasing WEIGHT_DECAY from 0.01 to 0.05 to improve generalization and see if it prevents overfitting at this lower learning rate.
